sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Distribution of Certified Civil Aircraft Rotables and Avionics Surplus

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China–Vanuatu Bilateral Investment Treaty (Agreement for the Promotion and Protection of Investments)
France–Vanuatu Bilateral Investment Treaty (Agreement on the Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) and Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA)
Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of the Republic of Vanuatu, as amended, read with the International Companies Regulations; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000, as amended, constituting the national AML/CFT law; beneficial-ownership and registered-agent rules issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); AML/CFT directives and guidance of the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of government-issued passport for each director, shareholder and any ultimate beneficial owner with 25% or more interest
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the relevant country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized police clearance or certificate of good conduct for each individual UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent criminal records authority in country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter issued within the last 3 months on letterhead of a licensed commercial bank
Notarized source of wealth statement and source of funds declaration, including provenance of aviation spare-part trading funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent notary public in the applicant's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, register of directors and members, and certificate of incumbency for any corporate shareholder or intermediate holding entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registrar of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified English or French translation of any non-English or non-French document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator in the country of origin, notarially certified

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, registered beneficial owners, controllers, signatories and high-value counterparties against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, HMT UK sanctions lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit national risk register and watchlists. Screening is performed at onboarding, continuously during the relationship, and before each escrow or SWIFT wire transaction. Any politically exposed person (PEP), family member or close associate of a PEP is subject to enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, source-of-funds verification and increased monitoring. Refusal to provide UBO information or the existence of negative sanctions media is a mandatory refusal or escalation ground under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000 as amended.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level_additional_notes: UBO data is held by the licensed registered agent and is accessible to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and other competent authorities; it is not a publicly searchable register.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies and International Companies Registry; online portal at www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names are checked in the Latin alphabet. English and French are accepted as statutory languages; Bislama and foreign-script names require a certified romanized transliteration and an English or French translation. The approved Latin-script form is the controlling name on all certificates. The name must include the appropriate limited-liability suffix for an International Company (e.g., 'International Company', 'IC', 'Limited' or 'Ltd' as permitted under the International Companies Act) and must be distinguishable from all names already on the VFSC register.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act (Cap. 222) of Vanuatu (Act No. 32 of 1992), ss. 4-12 (registration and incorporation), s. 42 (registered office), ss. 49-52 (licensed registered agent); Business Licence Act exclusion for offshore International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-01) subscribed by the founding member and lodged through a VFSC-licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital under Cap. 222; the memorandum typically authorizes US$50,000 divided into 1,000 ordinary shares of US$1.00 par value. No escrow or capital deposit is required; shares may be allotted for cash, promissory notes, or other consideration approved by the directors.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company, incorporated under the International Companies Act Cap 222 of Vanuatu on the date stated in its Certificate of Incorporation, adopts its Memorandum and Articles of Association as registered. FURTHER RESOLVED that the subscription for 1,000 ordinary shares of US$1.00 each by the founding member is accepted and the allotment approved. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office in Port Vila, maintained by the licensed registered agent, is adopted as the Company's statutory address. FURTHER RESOLVED that [Director A] and [Director B] are appointed directors and [Officer C] is appointed corporate secretary, empowered to execute ordinary-course documents. FURTHER RESOLVED that the directors and registered agent are authorized to pay all VFSC registration fees and complete ancillary statutory filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and shareholder/director due-diligence clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry — online portal via a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request confirming the proposed name ends with 'Limited' and is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. Simultaneously provide certified identification for the beneficial owner and director nominees for VFSC-style sanctions screening; the registered agent completes the CDD checklist before lodging.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name
Draft Memorandum of Association
Certified passport copies of subscriber and nominee directors
Banker's reference or professional reference
Engagement letter from VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is reserved by another entity or deemed impermissible, select a revised name from the VFSC alternative list; resubmission within five business days carries no additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of constitutional documents and statutory declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent and notary public in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, specifying authorized share capital, share classes, director powers, and the name of the Vanuatu registered agent; each director signs the statutory consent and the subscriber signs the declaration of compliance under s. 6 of Cap. 222; the registered agent pre-approves the text for VFSC formatting.
required_dossiers: Signed and subscribed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory declaration of compliance (s. 6, Cap. 222)
Consent to act forms for directors and corporate secretary
Registered office consent from the licensed agent
Agent's internal incorporation instruction sheet
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any clause, amend the instrument by unanimous written resolution of the subscriber, re-sign the offending pages, and resubmit within three days; no new name reservation is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC lodgement and payment of government fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies, Port Vila (physical or e-filing counter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the full incorporation package with Form IC-01 and remits the government incorporation fee (approx. US$250) plus the first annual licence fee (approx. US$230) by banker's draft or SWIFT credit to the VFSC designated account. Lodgement is on a first-come, first-served basis.
required_dossiers: Form IC-01 registration application
Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed file)
Declaration of compliance
VFSC fee payment receipt
Certified details of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a VFSC requisition letter, the registered agent files a responding memorandum curing the cited defect; VFSC re-examines within two business days. Failure to cure within thirty days triggers withdrawal, and a fresh application may be filed with a refund claim for unused fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and corporate security kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number. The registered agent then prepares the corporate kit: share certificates, registers of members and directors, minute book, and any printed corporate seal, and delivers it to the client against signed acceptance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued)
Allotment and share certificates for founding member
Register of members and directors
Registered agent certificate of custody
Seal attestation (optional) if a common seal is adopted
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors in the certificate are corrected by a re-issue request to the Registrar within ten days at no cost; substantive errors require a supplementary resolution of the board and a VFSC administrative rectification form.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation governance activation, KYC file closure, and optional local clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Compliance and Supervision Division; Department of Industry (exemption declaration); local fire and building authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the agent's statutory CDD/AML file, open the statutory registers at the registered office, pre-pay the annual confirmation statement to VFSC, and, if the company elects to maintain a back-office in Port Vila for logistics coordination, file the Business Licence Act exemption declaration and obtain a fire-safety certificate for the office premises.
required_dossiers: Completed CDD/AML file (subscriber, directors, ultimate beneficial owner)
Register of members and directors (signed copy)
Annual confirmation statement and fee receipt
Business licence exemption declaration (if back office maintained)
Fire and building occupancy certificate (if back office maintained)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC supervision flags incomplete CDD, the registered agent suspends distributions until supplementary evidence (source of funds, corporate chart) is filed; for fire certification, remediate identified defects and re-inspection is completed within five working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (Licensing and Supervision Division) for the statutory company licence; Vanuatu Civil Aviation Authority (VCAA) provides advisory endorsement for physical aviation parts transiting or warehoused in Vanuatu.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Certificate of Incorporation and annual licence under Cap. 222 (exclusive statutory authorization; Business Licence Act exemption applies to offshore trading); commercial prerequisite of FAA AC 00-56B / EASA Part 145 release certificates for each surplus aircraft part batch.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and Disaster Management, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt Category C under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act No. 12 of 2002; pure offshore distribution with no manufacturing, unpacking, or disassembly in Vanuatu requires only a written self-declaration of non-compliance, not a full EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC discharge permitted in Vanuatu; any aviation part with residual hydraulic fluid, fuel, or lithium batteries must remain in sealed shipping containers and be handled under IATA DGR at a licensed logistics facility; wastewater, if a bonded warehouse is ever established, must meet Port Vila municipal sewer limits (BOD5 ≤ 20 mg/L, pH 6-9); waste oil and solvents must be removed by a DEPC-licensed contractor with manifests retained for five years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services administrative fire-safety clearance for any Port Vila back office (extinguishers, evacuation plan, single-occupancy limit); structural load verification by a Vanuatu-registered engineer under the Vanuatu Building Code if warehousing is added; occupational health registration with the Department of Labour (WorkSafe Unit) applies only if employees are engaged inside Vanuatu, with the offshore entity otherwise exempt as it conducts all operations abroad.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: http://www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must apply for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by filing Form TIN-01 with the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department, accompanied by certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, Registered Agent certificate, and valid passport for each director. The International Company (IC) is registered as a tax-exempt non-resident entity; no VAT registration is available or required. Processing takes approximately 5 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The Vanuatu International Company is statutorily tax-exempt; there is no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election mechanism. No election to be treated as a pass-through or entity-level taxpayer is recognised under Vanuatu law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT, GST, or sales and use tax is imposed in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Customs import duties and export duties (where applicable) are administered under the Customs Tariff Act, payable at clearance.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping requirement is imposed. Customs declarations are processed via UNCTAD's ASYCUDA World system for import/export clearance only.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – because Vanuatu levies no VAT/GST, there is no zero-rating mechanism, no export refund claim, and no VAT registration trigger. Exports of surplus commercial aircraft parts are exempt from any export duty under applicable customs law, subject to documentation requirements.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating or refund clawback mechanism exists within Vanuatu. Fraudulent customs declarations (including undervaluation or misdescription of exported goods) are subject to penalties of up to 300% of duties evaded, confiscation of goods, revocation of trade licenses, and administrative fines under the Customs Act. False filings under the International Companies Act attract separate civil penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the Central Bank and residual exchange-control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 77]; daily exchange-control administration is delegated to authorized dealers (licensed commercial banks) under RBV oversight.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is administered by the RBV through a managed arrangement against a trade-weighted basket of major partner currencies. Current-account convertibility is unrestricted for non-residents, and an International Company (IC) constituted under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is treated as non-resident, exempt from resident capital-account controls; profit and dividend remittances require no exchange-control approval and are exempt from withholding taxes under the IC tax-exemption regime. Trade liquidity is strong because settlement is USD-denominated and may be held offshore in unrestricted foreign-currency accounts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender requirement or mandatory conversion ratio on export proceeds earned by non-resident ICs; USD trade receipts may be retained in full. Resident exporters are subject only to administrative reporting through authorized dealers, and the IC's surplus-aircraft-parts receivables may flow directly into USD operational or escrow accounts without VUV conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Restricted USD Capital Escrow Account plus USD Operational Trading Account
USD Operational Foreign-Currency Account with Trade Finance Desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium, conditional. Select EU/UK-licensed EMIs accept Vanuatu ICs for USD clearing only where the IC supplies a VFSC registered-agent referral, audited financial statements, and a civil-aviation trade dossier; most tier-1 EMIs decline remote offshore ICs under de-risking policies. EMIs cannot deliver commercial LC, aviation escrow, or physical trade-desk instruments, so they are suitable only as capped auxiliary disbursement rails, never as the primary clearing bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Fully remote account opening is generally permitted for ICs: the bank accepts certified corporate documents authenticated by the VFSC-licensed registered agent, together with a live video due-diligence interview with all directors. Physical attendance in Port Vila is not statutorily required; however, under the Medium_Risk_Enhanced classification, the authorized dealer may impose one in-person or notarized countersignature at the registered agent's office before transaction limits exceed the USD 250,000 threshold.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity of the Vanuatu International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register of directors and beneficial owners maintained by the VFSC-licensed registered agent; ownership-chain chart; notarized passports of all UBOs; agent's client due-diligence record; signed non-resident declaration confirming the IC does not transact with Vanuatu residents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dual-use and counterfeit risk in surplus commercial aircraft parts and avionics
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FAA Form 8130-3 or EASA Form 1 airworthiness certificates per rotable; EASA Part-145 release records; original OEM invoice and batch traceability; CAAV statutory dealer license; ECCN/US BIS export-control classification memo confirming sole civil-aviation application.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds difficulty on high-value escrow settlements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited IC financial statements; escrow agent's authenticated settlement and instruction statements; underlying purchase orders, air waybills and bills of lading; 12-month bank transaction history; funds-flow certificate issued by the licensed aviation escrow provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-haven presumption triggering correspondent-bank de-risking
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incumbency and tax-exemption certificate; VFSC economic-substance filing; CAAV dealer license and active purchase/supply contracts; registered-agent physical administration file and office-address verification; audited financial statements demonstrating real trading substance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity injections arrive via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's licensed bank using ISO 20022 purpose code TRAD or INVC as applicable, with a clear capital-contribution narrative in field 70 (Share Capital Injection) referencing the IC name and registered-agent file number; the authorized dealer also requires a board resolution, share-subscription agreement, and source-of-funds confirmation. Inbound escrow settlement receivables must cite the purchase order, air waybill, and escrow instruction reference, crediting only the designated USD Capital Escrow or Operational Account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments up to USD 250,000 are cleared by SWIFT MT103 with invoice, packing-list, and airworthiness-certificate matching; procurements above USD 250,000 settle via irrevocable commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) opened through the authorized dealer's trade desk, with suppliers presenting compliant airworthiness and shipping documents against the LC. Escrow disposition proceeds are released only on authenticated SWIFT instruction from the aviation escrow agent against the restricted Capital Escrow Account; all outbound flows undergo dual-use counterparty screening and airway-bill verification under Medium_Risk_Enhanced monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV forward contracts with authorized dealers (tenor up to 6 months, best-efforts pricing given thin onshore forward liquidity)
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD/VUV executed through an offshore bank or EMI to hedge VUV exposure without domestic approval
USD/VUV cross-currency swaps with counterparty banks holding simultaneous USD and VUV balances
Structural natural hedging by retaining USD receivables in multi-currency accounts and minimizing forced VUV conversion

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission / Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed late penalty of VUV 25,000; continuous default may trigger a notice of intention to strike off and, for licensed aviation parts distributors, suspension of the relevant VFSC business licence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due concurrently with the annual return on the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% penalty if unpaid after 30 days; 25% penalty after 90 days; unpaid fees for six consecutive months expose the International Company to administrative strike-off and loss of asset-holding and trade protections.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None applicable to a tax-exempt International Company engaged solely in wholesale distribution of surplus commercial aircraft parts; audit is compulsory only if the company holds a financial-services licence or if shareholders holding at least 10% of voting rights deliver a written audit demand.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or simplified Vanuatu GAAP for internal record-keeping; accounting records must be kept in English at the registered office and provide a true and fair view of the company's profit and loss and financial position.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A confidential beneficial-ownership register must be held at the registered office; any share transfer is recorded in the Register of Members and any underlying beneficial-ownership change is notified to the registered agent within 14 days. The annual return filed with VFSC confirms the current members, directors, share transfers executed during the year, and the continuing accuracy of the beneficial-ownership register.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 4,500 per annum if a voluntary audit is commissioned; not a statutory requirement for this exempt IC

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% general corporate income tax as no CIT statute is currently enacted; International Companies are explicitly exempt from any form of Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax under ss. 104-108 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0%; no preferential rate, tax holiday, or exemption certificate is available or needed because the tax base is nil. The IC can repatriate income free of any Vanuatu tax; only registry fees, annual licence fees, and economic substance filing fees apply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income tax return is prescribed or administered by the Vanuatu Department of Finance. The only recurring filing obligation for a Vanuatu International Company is the annual return prescribed by s.80 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (VFSC Form IC-AR), submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Must be delivered to VFSC no later than 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation; no extension of the anniversary deadline is granted for tax purposes because no tax filing occurs. Failure to file triggers registry strike-off procedures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu, including room/floor, building, street, province, and postal code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident IC must maintain the address of its licensed registered agent and may not use a post office box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the Vanuatu registered agent that holds the agent's consent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All non-resident ICs must appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent; enter the agent's e-registry account details.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, and nationality of all directors; state whether director is natural person or corporate director.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-residents and no work permit or visa is required; provide country of residence and not just a service address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership schedule: registered shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and trust/company layers in the ownership chain.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders need not be disclosed publicly, but the register of beneficial owners must be physically kept at the VFSC office and filed with the annual return in accordance with the Financial Transactions Reporting Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital and share classes: number of issued shares, par value (if any), and aggregate consideration received.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital applies; non-resident shareholders may issue shares in USD, VUV, EUR, or no-par value form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee schedule declaration: select IC type and amount of VFSC fee payable by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees are denominated in US Dollars and may be paid by USD wire transfer from the non-resident shareholder's bank; VAT is not imposed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Restrictions declaration: confirm the IC has not carried on business with a Vanuatu resident, has no Vanuatu real property, and has not used the company for a domestic aviation or domestic trading activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs trading surplus aircraft parts must conduct all dealings offshore or with foreign counterparties; any domestic Vanuatu transaction invalidates the exemption and requires a local business licence and tax registration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission attracts a VFSC late-penalty of VUV 25,000 plus a continuing daily surcharge of VUV 2,000 per business day until the return is filed. Default extending beyond 30 days may lead to administrative penalty of VUV 100,000, the company's name being struck off, and ultimate dissolution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%; Vanuatu has no dividend withholding tax and no act governing income tax withholding. Dividends declared by an International Company to foreign shareholders are paid free of Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable in substance: Vanuatu has not concluded a comprehensive double taxation agreement and does not impose withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, or management fees. An International Company requiring a formal proof of non-residence can apply to VFSC for a Tax Residency Certificate or Corporate Exemption Certificate, but no reduction, exemption, or refund procedure exists because no gross-basis levy is assessed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for cross-border royalties and 0% statutory rate for debt interest paid by an International Company; no treaty rate applies due to the absence of an OECD-standard DTA network. The zero withholding is conditioned on the payment being credited to a non-resident lender or licensor and on the IC not having a Vanuatu domestic source activity.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable under Vanuatu law: no Local File, Master File, Country-by-Country Reporting, or documentary threshold is codified in VUV because Vanuatu does not impose a corporate income tax. Foreign tax administrations may nevertheless impute arm's-length pricing on the IC's outbound aircraft-parts sales under their own transfer pricing regimes.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance (International Companies) Regulations apply to a Vanuatu IC that is tax resident and carries on a 'relevant activity'; distribution and service business, including aviation spares trading, is considered a relevant activity. Such an IC must file an economic substance declaration with VFSC demonstrating that it is directed and managed in Vanuatu, that core income-generating activities (e.g., contract negotiation, procurement, inventory management) take place in Vanuatu, and that it has adequate premises, VFSC-licensed registered agent, and full-time employees or data systems. Failure to satisfy economic substance is not cured by the zero-tax regime and exposes the IC to financial penalties, strike-off, and information exchange.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a Vanuatu IC as a paper intermediary solely to interpose tax-exempt invoices between a non-resident supplier and a foreign aviation customer, while the actual purchasing, warehousing, and decision-making functions occur in a high-tax jurisdiction; structuring artificially low markups to leave no taxable profit in the source country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax to evade, but the conduct facilitates evasion abroad. Sanctions are imposed by the destination jurisdiction: reassessment, interest, 100% anti-avoidance penalties, and criminal prosecution for intentional foreign tax evasion. In Vanuatu, VFSC may impose an administrative penalty under the Economic Substance Regulations for filing a false substance declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors can be held personally liable for unlawful trading where the IC is a vehicle of fraud; courts may pierce the corporate veil and issue confiscation orders, travel bans, and custodial sentences of up to seven years for fraudulent tax evasion in the foreign jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating an International Company with no employees, no physical presence, no bank account in Vanuatu, and no VFSC substance declaration, and using it as the 'main distributor' for aviation surplus parts to derive tax exemptions in a zero-tax zone.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC administrative penalties for non-compliance with the Economic Substance (International Companies) Regulations range from an initial penalty of up to VUV 500,000 and a continuing penalty of VUV 100,000 per month; the IC may be struck off and dissolved and its directors may be disqualified.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable to the extent of assets extracted from the shell, joint and several with the company for penalties arising from false declarations, and may be prohibited from leaving Vanuatu pending an economic substance inquiry.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Domestic Trading and Customs Offences
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling surplus certified aircraft parts to Vanuatu carriers, physically delivering stock into Port Vila, or importing/exporting aviation material without the required Vanuatu business licence and Ministry of Infrastructure permit; using an IC to circumvent the prohibition on domestic Vanuatu activities is an aggravating factor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 163] and the International Companies Act: fines of up to VUV 200,000 per transaction, forfeiture of goods, revocation of the business licence, and if customs duties are evaded, criminal liability under the Customs Act including imprisonment and exclusion from procurement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorise unlicensed domestic sales are individually fined and can be imprisoned for up to 12 months; the Vanuatu Customs Comptroller may issue a travel ban while the company is under investigation and may seize directors' personal assets used in the unlawful business.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving payment for surplus aircraft parts from sanctioned airlines or intermediaries through Swift wires or aviation escrow accounts without beneficial-ownership checks, without transaction monitoring, or while the IC's bank files report non-existent substance or suspicious wires are intentionally mislabelled as 'technical services'.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the Financial Transactions Reporting Act (FTRA) 2020: monetary penalties up to VUV 15 million, asset freezing, and imprisonment up to five years. The VFSC can also suspend or revoke the registered agent's licence and cause the IC to be wound up.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners are individually liable if they 'knowingly aid' money laundering; personal criminal fines of VUV 10 million and custodial sentences up to five years apply, and any director under investigation may be barred from travelling abroad.
